chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu'alla ibn Muhammad and Ali ibn Muhammad from Salih ibn Abi Hammad, all from Al-Wasshash, from Ahmad ibn A'iz, from Abu Khadeeja, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Lying upon Allah and upon His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) is from the major sins.
ai.seo_question: What is considered a major sin when lying about Allah and His Messenger?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kafi by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elevates lying about Allah and the Prophet to the status of al-kaba'ir (major sins), establishing a critical criterion for the authenticity of religious reports (akhbar). This classification underscores the theological weight of tawhid in narration, where distorting divine speech is akin to a major breach of covenant. It serves as a foundational ethical and jurisprudential principle for evaluating the reliability of transmitted knowledge in Shia scholarship.
